blocks.text: Grandview homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Grandview, September 2026. Detached houses: 66 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 146 listed at month end and 20 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 37 sold over 4 months against an average of 67.0 listed, about 7.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 12 sold. Condos and townhomes: 105 sold over 4 months against an average of 155.2 listed, about 5.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 33 sold.

items.t: In the SnapStats data the row is named simply "Grandview", one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock". Morgan Crossing, the retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street, sits INSIDE Grandview and its homes use this Grandview board row; Morgan Creek is a different sub-area with its own row, never used for Grandview. The street-level board boundary is UNVERIFIED — no public street-level boundary was opened, and no municipal boundary was substituted.

City planning frame: the City's approved South Surrey land use plans for Grandview Heights include the North Grandview Heights NCP (land uses for the neighbourhoods north of 28 Avenue from King George Boulevard to Highway 15) and the Morgan Heights NCP (the first urban residential neighbourhood in Grandview Heights).

Where the condo stock concentrates: in the Morgan Crossing / Grandview Corners village ground at 24 Avenue / 160 Street — Croydon Drive and 26 Avenue addresses, residences above and beside the shops — inside the wider Grandview attached shelf.

Community context only (whole S Surrey White Rock community, NOT Grandview's prices): Detached median $1,628,000; Condos & Townhomes median $700,000 / $524 per sq ft / 99% sale-to-list / 33 DOM. Per-sub-area medians are not published: UNVERIFIED at sub-area level. NOT this area's row, stated to prevent the error: Morgan Creek — Detached 45 / 5 / 11%; Condos & Townhomes 39 / 9 / 23%.
Transit: UNVERIFIED — no TransLink timetable for a Grandview route was opened in the research pass.

faq.q: Is Grandview in South Surrey the same as Grandview-Woodland in Vancouver?
faq.a: No. This Grandview is Grandview Heights in South Surrey, Surrey — the MLS® sub-area "Grandview Surrey" (F57) — while Grandview-Woodland is a separate City of Vancouver local area around Commercial Drive; the live page states the distinction directly

faq.q: What kind of homes sell most in Grandview?
faq.a: On the page's own Paragon past-sales table (site copy), townhouses were the most-sold type in sub-area F57 over October 1, 2025 to September 29, 2026 — 207 townhouse sales against 83 detached and 45 apartment/condo sales, at 12-month medians of $833,000, $1,775,000 and $550,000 respectively

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Grandview?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 66 houses listed with 9 sold in the month and 146 condos and townhomes listed with 20 sold in the month in Grandview. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Grandview a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 14%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 14%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Is Morgan Crossing the same as Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No. Morgan Crossing is the retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street inside Grandview Heights, on the Grandview board row; Morgan Creek is the separate golf-course sub-area with its own row (September 2026: Detached 45 / 5 / 11%; attached 39 / 9 / 23%) — never used for Grandview. Morgan Crossing ≠ Morgan Creek.

faq.q: How many verified condo buildings does Grandview have?
faq.a: Buy on the Form B and the strata records, not the page table.
No building is counted twice, and none is promoted to verified here.

faq.q: Axis, Arc or Summit House — which building is 15850 26 Avenue?
faq.a: UNRESOLVED. All three names appear at the same civic address in page-table, feed and listing text, and Summit House's year conflicts (2010 vs 2011). Confirm the strata plan number and legal description for the specific unit before comparing fees or sales history.

faq.q: Is Harlowe in Pacific Douglas or Grandview?
faq.a: Either way it is a Genaris presale (86 homes: 25 townhomes + 61 condos), not resale stock and not 55+.

faq.q: Is Harlowe a resale I can move into, and is it 55+?
faq.a: Neither. Harlowe (Genaris, 16485 18 Ave) is a presale — 86 homes (25 townhomes + 61 condos) with completion "early 2028" as the developer states it — and it is explicitly NOT 55+.

faq.q: How did Grandview sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached 66 / 9 / 14% and Condos & Townhomes 146 / 20 / 14% — the second-largest attached pool in S Surrey White Rock. Never quote Morgan Creek's row (45 / 5 / 11%; 39 / 9 / 23%) for Grandview.
